source: HSReplay comps react_context + per-comp How to Play

comps.name: Beasts - Beetles
comps.how_to_play: With early [[Ravaging Scorpid||132949]] or [[Turquoise Skitterer||119255]], start scaling the stats of beetles. [[Headhunter Gryphon||132800]] can help you generate pieces of the comp with the help of [[Snarky Shark||132804]]. Run as many [[Banana Slamma||98824]] as possible, as they double the attack of your beetles and helps deals with high HP boards.

comps.name: Demons - Self Damage
comps.how_to_play: The idea of this comp is to use effects such as [[Malchezaar, Prince of Dance||99199]], [[Wrath Weaver||59670]], or trinkets to deal damage to your hero, and [[Ashen Corruptor||121687]] to negate this damage. [[Tichondrius||99228]] is some payoff for self damage, and used to stabilize in the midgame. Cupcakes generation with [[Eredar Escapist||133028]] is your main payoff for the lategame, targetting [[Ashen Corruptor||121687]] to buff your shop. [[Balinda Stonehearth||130298]] doubles the effect of both Cupcakes and [[Devilish Distractor||132901]]. With [[Wrath Weaver||59670]], every single Demon played makes your next spell free which generates a ton of value. The best demon generation is from [[Brann Bronzebeard||96786]] and cycling [[Imposing Percussionist||99232]].
comps.when_to_commit: [[Ashen Corruptor||121687]] + self damage ([[Wrath Weaver||59670]] or [[Malchezaar, Prince of Dance||99199]]) + payoff ([[Tichondrius||99228]] or [[Eredar Escapist||133028]])

comps.name: Elementals - Unbound Tempest
comps.summary: Play elementals to scale from big shop
comps.how_to_play: Buff the shop with either [[Nomi, Kitchen Nightmare||63626]] or [[Air Revenant||126173]], whichever method you find first. Use [[Brann Bronzebeard||96786]] + [[Tavern Tempest||64077]] + [[Kelp Keeper||132883]] for massive economy and elemental generation. You may use [[Flaming Enforcer||126924]] to stabilize in the midgame, and [[Unbound Tempest||132983]] to cap out your scaling. With tempest, cycle premium elementals such as [[Sellemental||64038]] and [[Refreshing Anomaly||64042]].
comps.when_to_commit: [[Brann Bronzebeard||96786]] + shop buff ([[Nomi, Kitchen Nightmare||63626]]) + [[Unbound Tempest||132983]]

comps.name: Undead - Attack Scaling
comps.how_to_play: Scale the attack of your Undeads and summons with the Butchering spell from [[Drustfallen Butcher||120104]]. Butchering spell improves with spell scaling from [[Friendly Geist||120219]]. Your quality of summons come from [[Handless Forsaken||95265]]. [[Snazzy Phantom||133083]] provides a ton of attack and health to your right most unit in combat, but also during the shop phase. Start using Butchering spells on your reborn cards with [[Snazzy Phantom||133083]] on board to capture permanent stats. The best variation of this comp is to run [[Dead Bellringer||132322]] + [[Mummifier||108992]] to first reborn your entire board. Then, with a full hand of butchering and also Snazzy, use bellringer activate on the mummifier, then the bellringer will get reborn, and then butcher the bellringer, and repeat for all your butchering spells. This'll give you an insane amount of Snazzy procs.

comps.name: Beasts - Tasty Lobstah
comps.how_to_play: Trigger [[Tasty Lobster||132796]] deathrattle as many times as possible. This is done with multiple rallies + [[Deathstrider||132808]] and [[Titus Rivendare||97408]], triggering Lobster deathrattle upon every rally. Trigger the lobster deathrattle during shop phase using golden [[Headhunter Gryphon||132800]] and buying every [[Snarky Shark||132804]] and [[Lurking Lionfish||132794]]. Reborn taunt your lobster, and then windfury your Gryphon with [[Sprightly Scarab||108909]].

comps.name: Elementals - Stat scaling
comps.how_to_play: Buff your stat scaling through either [[Moat Custodian||132981]] or early [[Glowing Cinder||119951]]. Then, if you have Manasurge, cycle every good elemental ([[Sellemental||64038]], [[Tavern Tempest||64077]], [[Refreshing Anomaly||64042]], [[Sand Swirler||119949]]). It's even better if you cycle those cards with [[Brann Bronzebeard||96786]]. The best elemental engine in the game is [[Kelp Keeper||132883]] + [[Tavern Tempest||64077]] or [[Gentle Djinni]] if Murlocs are in. If your economy is really good you can add [[Unbound Tempest||132983]] while buffing the shop,
comps.when_to_commit: [[Unleashed Mana Surge||120674]] + [[Brann Bronzebeard||96786]] + Stat scaling ([[Glowing Cinder||119951]])

comps.name: Mechs - Magnetics/Spells
comps.how_to_play: Put targetted spells on mechs as much as possible with [[Glambot||132893]] on board. [[Balinda Stonehearth||130298]] doubles the effect. Best to have spell generation such as [[Captain Cookie||133075]]. Cycle good gem cards such as [[Fearless Foodie||113154]] and buy good spells such as 3 pointy arrow spell. Eventually, buy [[Utility Drone||98588]] to capitalize on the magnetics you attached with Glambot in the midgame.

comps.name: Murlocs - Venom Scam
comps.summary: Buy scam cards and try to preserve placements
comps.how_to_play: Buy all the scam cards and try to preserve placements by killing as many units as possible. Keep your strongest units on the board (that's why you want to concentrate stats!) and fill the rest of the board with units that may be able to trade 1 for 1. Aim to golden [[Expert Aviator||126637]] and give it venom using [[Bile Spitter||122219]]. Then, the Aviator will pull many scam units from your hand. Could give murlocs permanent Venom using [[Sky-hatch Runaway||132957]] as well.
comps.when_to_commit: When you have no future or are clearly getting outstatted

comps.name: Murlocs - Tidecaller
comps.how_to_play: First, have a ton of economy, typically starting from golden [[Brann Bronzebeard||96786]] or Brann + [[Magicfin Mycologist||122277]], remembering premium economy spells such as Cloning Conch or Battlecry Discovery. Then, your payoff card for all that economy is [[Shamanic Tidecaller||133026]]. Paired with [[Balinda Stonehearth||130298]], play as many spells on the tidecaller as possible, which could be bloodgems or [[Oozeling Gladiator||103670]] spells. Scale premium murlocs in hand such as [[Bile Spitter||122219]] and [[Expert Aviator||126637]] so you can summon them and also [[Choral Mrrrglr||98948]] can capture all of the stats of the murlocs in your hand.

comps.name: Undead - APM Undead
comps.summary: Scale undead attack with infinite gold
comps.how_to_play: [[Sky Admiral Rogers||122516]] combined with [[Proud Privateer||122520]] gives you lots of gold to hit more of your setup.  Additional cards that help you become infinite include [[Enterprising Escapee||132762]] and [[Brann Bronzebeard||96786]], but can be cut once you commit more undeads to your board. Cycle every single free card ([[Refreshing Anomaly||64042]]) so you stay infinite. After you're infinite, scale undead attack using bounties + [[Forsaken Weaver||126733]]. Run a reborn golden [[Handless Forsaken||95265]] to be strong. Also use [[Snazzy Phantom||133083]] and cycle every single destroy undead effect such as [[Maw Caster||121508]] and [[Disguised Graverobber||104610]] to destroy reborns and give snazzy permanent stats.
comps.when_to_commit: Bounty Generation ([[Sky Admiral Rogers||122516]]) + [[Proud Privateer||122520]] + [[Forsaken Weaver||126733]]

comps.name: Dragons - APM Evoker
comps.how_to_play: [[Fire-Forged Evoker||120301]] scales with the amount of spells you cast. Your spell generation comes from casting bounties with [[Sky Admiral Rogers||122516]] and [[Proud Privateer||122520]]. Must be infinite with this comp, may use [[Brann Bronzebeard||96786]] or [[Enterprising Escapee||132762]] to help achieve that. Cycle every cheap card ([[River Skipper||122092]]) to spend gold and stay infinite. Leave [[Persistent Poet||108463]] on your board to capture permanent stats from Evoker. The best dragon to scale is [[Warpwing||92413]]. Get permanent divine shield and windfury on it using [[Amber guardian||95006]] and [[Thousandth Paper Drake||108116]] to end on in a turn.

comps.name: Pirates - APM Golden
comps.summary: Use infinite money to scale pirates
comps.how_to_play: Go infinite with [[Enterprising Escapee||132762]] + [[Sky Admiral Rogers||122516]] + [[Proud Privateer||122520]] setup, [[Brann Bronzebeard||96786]] helps to get the ball rolling. With the escapee, you'll play a lot of goldens and discovers, both of which helps with [[Hooktusk, Master Marauder||132925]]. Scale by being infinite and buying discover effects.  ADVANCED PLAYERS: Pivot higher cap which is demons shop buff comp

comps.name: Beasts - Summons
comps.how_to_play: First, have [[Headhunter Gryphon||132800]] in the midgame to start generating many beasts and along the way, generate the core pieces to this comp. Then, proc [[Goldrinn, the Great Wolf||59955]] during shop phase with the help of [[Deathstrider||132808]]. [[Titus Rivendare||97408]] also doubles the effectiveness of this strategy. Force your Gryphon to attack using [[Lurking Lionfish||132794]] activate or cycling [[Snarky Shark||132804]]. Best case is when you chain shop attacks by generating more Lionfish and Sharks. Then, use [[Sewer Lord||130996]] and [[Banana Slamma||98824]] to benefit from the aura from Goldrinn and summon huge attack beasts.

comps.name: Beasts - Leviathan
comps.how_to_play: Summon as many beasts as possible after you get early [[Lurking Leviathan||130711]]. The best beast summoner is reborned [[Sewer lord||130996]]. Hoarding Hyena summons a taunt summon which is the next best. Then, paired with [[Banana Slamma||98824]], every summon will have a ton of attack.

comps.name: Demons - APM Shop Buff
comps.summary: Cast spells to consume buffed shop.
comps.how_to_play: You must have an insane amount of economy to go for this comp. This is usually achieved with a turn 9 Brann + Rogers + Privateer. When you have too much economy, you will buy all targeted spells to use on [[Devilish Distractor||132901]] + [[Balinda Stonehearth||130298]] to scale the shop. You may also buff the shop cycling bloom gem buffers and buying every gem barrage card. You'll also generate a ton of spells by being infinite, allowing [[Felboar||110664]] or [[Twisted Wrathguard||130662]] to eat a huge shop over and over again. Brann and Escapee are additional tools to be infinite.

comps.name: Demons - Shop Buff
comps.how_to_play: Scale your shop with [[Devilish Distractor||132901]], best when paired with [[Balinda Stonehearth||130298]]. Then, your payoff for the buffed shop is most commonly [[Felboar||110664]], but it could also be [[Twisted Wrathguard||130662]] and/or reborn [[Imp-lusionist||132899]]. Use [[Methodical Madness||132903]] spells on shops with Divine shield or Venomous to give these keywords to all your demons.

comps.name: Murlocs - Family
comps.how_to_play: Generate [[Papa Mrrglton||131147]] or [[Mama Mrrglton||131145]] early on with [[Cousin Errgl||131149]]. Use [[Brann Bronzebeard||96786]] to double the effect of all of these battlecries. [[Primalfin Lookout||60028]] is a great battlecry to cycle to generate more Papas and Mamas, and buy every Papa and Mama from shop as well. Leave a golden Mrrglton on your board to proc with [[Kelp Keeper||132883]]. Could choose to buff premium murlocs such as [[Bile Spitter||122219]] or [[Expert Aviator||126637]] that can summon scam units.

comps.name: Quilboar - Bristlemane
comps.summary: Cast spells on Quilboar to scale.
comps.how_to_play: First, have gems scaled, usually with early [[Gem Rat||116434]]. Then, use [[Vigilant Bristlemane||132320]] to cast gems on the most premium card which is [[Blade Collector||99035]] or any premium dark gifts. Balinda is crucial to double Bristemane's effect. Concentrate all your gems on your juggernaut every turn using your Gem Confiscation from [[Trench Fighter||126671]]. In the endgame, starting filling out your board with ending units such as [[Leeroy the Reckless||90425]].

comps.name: Mechs - Magnetics
comps.how_to_play: With [[Spark Snapper||132676]], generate as many magnetics as possible so every magnet you play is huge. The best generation is [[Scrap Scraper||98592]]. Then, use [[Drone Duplicator||132312]] to duplicate a big magnetic a turn, preferable [[Accord-o-tron||98576]] for money.

comps.name: Quilboar - Choose One
comps.summary: Play Choose One cards to scale
comps.how_to_play: First, have gem scaling, most commonly through [[Gem rat||116434]] but could be with [[Sanguine Refiner||122566]]. [[Turbo Hogrider||116195]] is the payoff for your gem scaling. It helps to have some choose one generation through [[Gem Rat||116434]] or [[Bramble Tunneler||132632]]. Additionally, cycle every decent choose one card (anything besides [[Intrepid Botanist||120223]] or [[Time Management||117573]]).

comps.name: Dragons - Battlecries
comps.how_to_play: [[Brann Bronzebeard||96786]] + [[Kalecgos, Arcane Aspect||60630]] gives all of your dragons +4/4 every single battlecry you play. You want to trigger as many battlecries as possible. After you have your setup, cycle only PREMIUM battlecries, such as [[Tavern Tempest||64077]], [[Refreshing Anomaly||64042]], [[Shell Collector||80740]] or [[Draconic Warden||126860]]. The highest cap is to find as many double attack spell every turn, and permanently double the attack of warpwing every turn with the help of [[Persistent Poet||108463]]. Additionally, permanently attach divine shield with [[Amber Guardian||95006]] and permanently attach Windfury on Warpwing with [[Thousandth Paper Drake||108116]].

comps.name: Mechs - Deathrattle
comps.how_to_play: First, have a deathrattle midgame to have a scaled [[Falling Sky Golem||130798]] already. Taunt reborn it. Resummon it with [[Kangor's apprentice||59935]]. Fill out the rest of your board with scam such as [[Leeroy the Reckless||90425]].

all_comps_including_dropped.name: Nagas - End Of Turn/Spell Buff
all_comps_including_dropped.summary: Scale end of turn with spell power
all_comps_including_dropped.how_to_play: [[Felfire Conjurer||120299]] buffs your spell power, while [[Fauna Whisperer||120905]] uses that spell power to buff your board at the end of the turn. Both effects are amplified by [[Drakkari Enchanter||101314]]. The best target to buff with [[Fauna Whisperer||120905]] is [[Gatekeeper Amalgam||133329]] because it is an all tribe which buffs all your tribed units, and also it additionally casts Misplaced Tea Sets which benefit from spell power. Buy cheap targetted spells to use on Amalgam when you have [[Balinda Stonehearth||130298]].
all_comps_including_dropped.when_to_commit: Spell power ([[Felfire Conjurer||120299]]) + [[Fauna Whisperer||120905]] or [[Gatekeeper Amalgam||133329]]

Your naga generation setup consists of [[Seafloor Recruiter||126916]] + [[Balinda Stonehearth||130298]] and/or [[Sky-Hatch Runaway||132957]]. After you have at least 2 Groundbreakers, cycle every naga that has a good effect on top of it, such as [[Shell collector||80740]] and [[Darkcrest Strategist||115555]].

all_comps_including_dropped.name: Murlocs - Family
all_comps_including_dropped.how_to_play: Generate [[Papa Mrrglton||131147]] or [[Mama Mrrglton||131145]] early on with [[Cousin Errgl||131149]]. Use [[Brann Bronzebeard||96786]] to double the effect of all of these battlecries. [[Primalfin Lookout||60028]] is a great battlecry to cycle to generate more Papas and Mamas, and buy every Papa and Mama from shop as well. Leave a golden Mrrglton on your board to proc with [[Kelp Keeper||132883]]. Could choose to buff premium murlocs such as [[Bile Spitter||122219]] or [[Expert Aviator||126637]] that can summon scam units.

all_comps_including_dropped.name: Quilboar - Bristlemane
all_comps_including_dropped.summary: Cast spells on Quilboar to scale.
all_comps_including_dropped.how_to_play: First, have gems scaled, usually with early [[Gem Rat||116434]]. Then, use [[Vigilant Bristlemane||132320]] to cast gems on the most premium card which is [[Blade Collector||99035]] or any premium dark gifts. Balinda is crucial to double Bristemane's effect. Concentrate all your gems on your juggernaut every turn using your Gem Confiscation from [[Trench Fighter||126671]]. In the endgame, starting filling out your board with ending units such as [[Leeroy the Reckless||90425]].

all_comps_including_dropped.name: Mechs - Magnetics
all_comps_including_dropped.how_to_play: With [[Spark Snapper||132676]], generate as many magnetics as possible so every magnet you play is huge. The best generation is [[Scrap Scraper||98592]]. Then, use [[Drone Duplicator||132312]] to duplicate a big magnetic a turn, preferable [[Accord-o-tron||98576]] for money.

all_comps_including_dropped.name: Quilboar - Choose One
all_comps_including_dropped.summary: Play Choose One cards to scale
all_comps_including_dropped.how_to_play: First, have gem scaling, most commonly through [[Gem rat||116434]] but could be with [[Sanguine Refiner||122566]]. [[Turbo Hogrider||116195]] is the payoff for your gem scaling. It helps to have some choose one generation through [[Gem Rat||116434]] or [[Bramble Tunneler||132632]]. Additionally, cycle every decent choose one card (anything besides [[Intrepid Botanist||120223]] or [[Time Management||117573]]).

all_comps_including_dropped.name: Dragons - Battlecries
all_comps_including_dropped.how_to_play: [[Brann Bronzebeard||96786]] + [[Kalecgos, Arcane Aspect||60630]] gives all of your dragons +4/4 every single battlecry you play. You want to trigger as many battlecries as possible. After you have your setup, cycle only PREMIUM battlecries, such as [[Tavern Tempest||64077]], [[Refreshing Anomaly||64042]], [[Shell Collector||80740]] or [[Draconic Warden||126860]]. The highest cap is to find as many double attack spell every turn, and permanently double the attack of warpwing every turn with the help of [[Persistent Poet||108463]]. Additionally, permanently attach divine shield with [[Amber Guardian||95006]] and permanently attach Windfury on Warpwing with [[Thousandth Paper Drake||108116]].

all_comps_including_dropped.name: Mechs - Deathrattle
all_comps_including_dropped.how_to_play: First, have a deathrattle midgame to have a scaled [[Falling Sky Golem||130798]] already. Taunt reborn it. Resummon it with [[Kangor's apprentice||59935]]. Fill out the rest of your board with scam such as [[Leeroy the Reckless||90425]].

all_comps_including_dropped.name: Beasts - Felhorn
all_comps_including_dropped.summary: Deal damage to your own board to scale.
all_comps_including_dropped.how_to_play: Use [[Rylak Metalhead]] + [[Felhorn]] to have your Felhorn deal damage to your minions multiple times. This will benefit your payoff cards such as [[Lord of the ruins]], which buffs your whole board, or [[Silky Shimmermoth]] which scales your beetles. [[Monstrous Macaw]], reborn, [[Brann Bronzebeard||96786]], [[Titus Rivendare||97408]] ALL provide multipliers for this effect, and stacking multipliers scales your board insanely fast. You usually use [[Refreshing Anomaly||64042]] instead of Felhorn at first to ramp up economy.

all_comps_including_dropped.name: Demons - Damage
all_comps_including_dropped.summary: Demons deal damage to buff board
all_comps_including_dropped.how_to_play: [[Lord of the Ruins]] buffs by having your demons deal damage to minions. The best way to do that is with [[Silent Enforcer]] + [[Titus Rivendare||97408]], which damages all your opponent's minions at once. [[Devout Hellcaller||122586]] and [[Tarecgosa||72062]] are ways to get permanent scaling.
all_comps_including_dropped.when_to_commit: [[Silent Enforcer]] + Damage payoff ([[Lord of the Ruins]])

all_comps_including_dropped.name: Demons - Shop Buff/Self Damage
all_comps_including_dropped.how_to_play: Your shop will be buffed by [[Ashen Corruptor||121687]] paired with [[Malchezaar, Prince of Dance||99199]] and/or [[Dream Inquisitor]]. Then, buy every cheap spell to eat the shop using [[Batty Terrorguard]]. [[Brann Bronzebeard||96786]] is typically used for spell generation through [[Rodeo Performer||104466]], and also to double effects from [[Mecha Jaraxxus]] and [[Imposing Percussionist||99232]].

all_comps_including_dropped.name: Dragons - Charmwing
all_comps_including_dropped.how_to_play:
Your first priority is to scale a [[Charmwing]]. This can be done with [[Persistent Poet||108463]] + [[Twilight Watcher]]. It can also be done by buffing the HP of spells using [[Blue Whelp||122674]] or [[Felfire Conjurer||120299]] and then generating spells with [[Greenskeeper]] + [[Firescale Hoarder||120213]]. The most common way to scale a Charmwing is APM Pirates. After you've scaled a Charmwing as much as possible, windfury it and give your other dragons permanent HP with the help of Poet.

With Nagas in, you can run [[Wrathscale Rogue]] + Amalgams or [[Firescale Hoarder||120213]] in order to buff dragons' health along with their attack.
all_comps_including_dropped.when_to_commit: [[Charmwing]] + way to scale it (Poet + Twilight Watcher)

all_comps_including_dropped.name: Dragons - Nightbane
all_comps_including_dropped.summary: Add stats to Dragons end of turn
all_comps_including_dropped.how_to_play: This comp gets high attack and Divine Shield to all your dragons. Position [[Nightbane, Ignited]] next to [[Persistent Poet||108463]] and scale them with [[Prized Promo-Drake]]. Then, after your Nightbanes die, your dragons next to the poet will captures all the attack. Finally, [[Nadina the Red]] or [[Amber Guardian||95006]] will put permanent Divine Shield on your buffed dragons.

all_comps_including_dropped.name: Dragons - Stuntdrake
all_comps_including_dropped.summary: Summon many high attack dragons in combat
all_comps_including_dropped.how_to_play: Scale a big [[Stuntdrake]] using [[Persistent Poet||108463]] + [[Twilight Watcher]], so that every time a dragon attacks in buffs your [[Stuntdrake]]. Then, you have [[Titus Rivendare||97408]] + [[Twilight Broodmother]] combo to have your dragons attack as many times as possible. With your scaled Stuntdrake, your summoned [[Twilight Hatchling]]s will also get a ton of attack. You may also choose to use [[Fire-forged Evoker||120301]] with spell generation to scale your [[Stuntdrake]] instead of [[Twilight Watcher]].
all_comps_including_dropped.when_to_commit: [[Stuntdrake]] + [[Twilight Hatchling]] + way to buff it ([[Twilight Watcher]])

all_comps_including_dropped.name: Elementals - Sandstone Master
all_comps_including_dropped.how_to_play: Every card played gives 1 attack to your [[Sandstone Drake]] which in turn gives [[Master of Realities]] +2/2. [[Drakkari Enchanter||101314]] and [[Whelp Smuggler]] both doubles the amount of procs. [[Brann Bronzebeard||96786]] is very important in order to cycle as many cards as possible every turn, and cards such as [[Lantern Lava]] and [[Sky Admiral Rogers||122516]] amplifies your economy and cards cycled. In the endgame, you may decide to avalanche your Master of Realities and fill in the rest of your board with ending units such as Leeroy.

all_comps_including_dropped.name: Elementals - Stat scaling/End Of Turn
all_comps_including_dropped.summary: Buff the stat scaling on your elementals to buff your board at the end of turn.
all_comps_including_dropped.how_to_play: [[Amplifying Lightspawn]] scales the stats of your stat scaling at the end of your turn, and [[Lokholar, Frostforger]] is your pay off that adds a bunch of stats to your board at the end of your turn while benefitting from stat scaling. [[Drakkari Enchanter||101314]] doubles the effectiveness of both of these cards.

all_comps_including_dropped.name: Elementals - Tavern 2 (SPECIFIC HEROES)
all_comps_including_dropped.how_to_play: STAY ON TAVERN 2! Cycle every single baller which makes your next baller larger. Hard to get first unless you're one of the enabled heroes.
all_comps_including_dropped.common_enablers_text: Gallywix, Nobundo (Strike oils), Kurtrus, or sometimes [[Marin the Manager||113310]] and [[Sire Denathrius||92960]]

all_comps_including_dropped.name: Elementals - Ultraviolet
all_comps_including_dropped.how_to_play: Cycle every single free card with [[Brann Bronzebeard||96786]], such as [[Refreshing Anomaly||64042]], [[Gentle Djinni]], or [[Hired Headhunter||105264]]. Then, use your economy to scale using [[Ultraviolet Ascendant]]. [[Sellemental||64038]] and [[Windfall Tornado]] are also always good to buy.

all_comps_including_dropped.name: Mechs - Automaton (SPECIFIC HEROES)
all_comps_including_dropped.how_to_play: Reborn your Automaton as soon as possible to start scaling it. Put naked [[Auto Assembler||120025]] on the board to also scale it. Roll on 5 for Kangors, and then you can fill out the rest of your comp with Leeroy and scam.
all_comps_including_dropped.common_enablers_text: Lich King, Akazamarak (Pack Tactics), and Teron Gorefield

all_comps_including_dropped.name: Mechs - Juggernaut
all_comps_including_dropped.how_to_play: BEST PLAYED WITH DRAGONS! Commit to this comp with a relatively early [[Moonsteel Juggernaut]] + [[Drakkari Enchanter||101314]]. Then, your objective is to trigger the end of turn effect as much as possible, usually through [[Efficient Engineer]] plus [[Brann Bronzebeard||96786]] and/or [[Young Murk-eye]].

all_comps_including_dropped.name: Mechs - Photobomber
all_comps_including_dropped.summary: Scale your bombs and unleash them.
all_comps_including_dropped.how_to_play: First, you need a spell generator. Most commonly, it's through [[Brann Bronzebeard||96786]] + [[Visionary Shipman]] + one more economy card such as [[Fleet Admiral Tethys]]. This will both give you the economy to find your Photobomber setup and scale it at the same time. [[Rylak Metalhead]] + [[Shell Collector||80740]] or [[Rodeo Performer||104466]] works for spell generation also. In the midgame, you may use [[Nalaa the Redeemer]] or [[Plankwalker]] to stabilize. Remember to reborn taunt your [[Photobomber]].

all_comps_including_dropped.name: Murlocs - 'Loc Prince
all_comps_including_dropped.how_to_play:
Every time you play a cheap or free battlecry with [[Brann Bronzebeard||96786]], the [[One-Amalgam Tour Group]] will buff the [['Loc Prince]] a bunch of times. Cycle every single [[Hackerfin]], [[Primalfin Lookout||60028]], [[Rodeo Performer||104466]], etc. Keeping other low tavern units such as [[Annoy-o-tron]] or [[Bubble Gunner]] is great so that your tour group scales them from every card you play.

With [[Hunter of Gatherers]] and a ton of economy, you can opt to scale with [[Reverber Drake]], [[Efficient Engineer]], and [[Drakkari Enchanter||101314]] as an alternative way to scale [['Loc Prince]].

all_comps_including_dropped.name: Murlocs - End of Turn
all_comps_including_dropped.how_to_play: will add

all_comps_including_dropped.name: Murlocs - Keyword
all_comps_including_dropped.summary: Add Keywords to Murlocs and buff them
all_comps_including_dropped.how_to_play: After you triple into [[Young Murk-eye]] and have a [[Brann Bronzebeard||96786]], put all possible keywords on your [[Bubble Gunner]], ideally you have 2 of them. Then, roll for [[Hackerfin]] and [[Drakkari Enchanter||101314]] to scale up your Gunners pretty fast. You also want your entire board to be taunted to get scaled by the Hackerfins as well.

all_comps_including_dropped.name: Murlocs - Mystic Menagerie
all_comps_including_dropped.how_to_play: Find [[Brann Bronzebeard||96786]] and [[Shoalfin Mystic]] and then either [[Greenskeeper]] or [[Rylak Metalhead]] to constantly proc the mystic. This will scale your spells a lot. Also keep some sort of spell generation on your board, for example [[Firescale Hoarder||120213]] or [[Gormling Gourmet]]. Once you feel like your spells are big enough, solely focus on spell generation using your Rylak/Greenskeepers setup.
all_comps_including_dropped.when_to_commit: [[Brann Bronzebeard||96786]] + [[Shoalfin Mystic]] + a way to proc it ([[Rylak Metalhead]]/[[Greenskeeper]]) + Spell Generation ([[Gormling Gourmet]])

all_comps_including_dropped.name: Nagas - Deep Blue
all_comps_including_dropped.how_to_play: Roll for [[Deep Blue Crooner]], [[Zesty Shaker||99054]], and [[Flaming Enforcer||126924]]. Put your spellcrafts on the shop with Enforcer to gain permanent stats. [[Balinda Stonehearth||130298]] doubles your deepblue stats and scaling if you use it on your board. [[Leyline Surfacer]] provides extra stats after you buff to shop to eat. After you have golden versions of everything, start filling out the rest of your board with scam such as [[Leeroy the Reckless||90425]].

all_comps_including_dropped.name: Nagas - Lord of Gains
all_comps_including_dropped.how_to_play: After you have your [[Slitherspear, Lord Of Gains]], buy every 1 cost spell that counts as a unique spell. Also, cycle blood gems and [[Oozeling Gladiator||103670]] for unique spells as well. If you have [[Groundbreaker||114816]], pivot to that comp.

all_comps_including_dropped.name: Nagas - Showy Cyclist
all_comps_including_dropped.how_to_play: First generate spellcrafts in the midgame. The only ways to do this are Timewarped Sapper and [[Profound Thinker]]. Then, [[Showy Cyclist||115565]] is a deathrattle that benefits from the spellcrafts you generated. [[Titus Rivendare||97408]], [[Monstrous Macaw]] and [[Weary Mage]] reborn all act as multipliers for this effect. You may choose to use [[Persistent Poet||108463]] and an Amalgam to keep permanent stats.
all_comps_including_dropped.when_to_commit: Spellcraft generation in the midgame ([[Profound Thinker]]) + [[Showy Cyclist||115565]]

all_comps_including_dropped.name: Nagas - Spell Buff/End of Turn
all_comps_including_dropped.summary: Cast Buffed Spells End of Turn
all_comps_including_dropped.how_to_play: Buff the spells, most commonly through early [[Felfire Conjurer||120299]] + [[Drakkari Enchanter||101314]].  The rest of your board are cards that can take advantage of the buffed spells. Fauna Whisperer benefits a lot from the end of turn/spell buff synergy, and ideally you put it next to an Nightmare Par-tea Guest to buff your entire board. [[Famished Felbat]] can eat the shop after you've buffed it using [[Fauna Whisperer||120905]], as long as you position it last.
all_comps_including_dropped.when_to_commit: Spell scaling([[Felfire Conjurer||120299]]) + [[Drakkari Enchanter||101314]] or Spell Generation ([[Fauna Whisperer||120905]])

all_comps_including_dropped.name: Nagas - T4 Spell Buff
all_comps_including_dropped.summary: Buff spells to make one huge naga.
all_comps_including_dropped.how_to_play: Use [[Tranquil Meditative||119942]] to scale your spells permanently. Also cycle every [[Shoalfin Mystic]] if you can. Your spell generation comes from [[Slumber Sorcerer]], where you can proc it extra times using Titus or Macaw. Finally, use all your naga spellcrafts on [[Corrupted Myrmidon]]. When it comes to lategame, remove all your scaling units besides [[Corrupted Myrmidon]] and replace it with tech cards such as [[Leeroy the Reckless||90425]]

all_comps_including_dropped.name: Pirates - Deathrattles
all_comps_including_dropped.summary: Summon high-attack pirates that attack immediately
all_comps_including_dropped.how_to_play: The idea of this comp is to summon a ton of high attack [[Sky Pirate]]s that attack immediately. [[Cruise Controller]] plus [[Titus Rivendare||97408]] combo gives your pirate summons tons of attack, and [[Sky Pirate Flagbearer]] plus [[Rapscallion Recruiter]] generates a ton of [[Scallywag]]s. Roll on tier 5 and buy as many of the Core/Addon pieces as possible.
all_comps_including_dropped.when_to_commit: [[Cruise Controller]] + [[Titus Rivendare||97408]] + Sky Pirate Generation ([[Rapscallion Recruiter]])

all_comps_including_dropped.name: Pirates - Eudora
all_comps_including_dropped.how_to_play: *MUST HAVE BEASTS* Proc [[Ship Master Eudora]] extra times with effects such as [[Titus Rivendare||97408]] and [[Monstrous Macaw]]. Macaw and Titus needs to be golden for this strat to work decent. Fill in the rest of your board with various goldens as well, usually its [[Aureate Laureate||119996]].
all_comps_including_dropped.when_to_commit: [[Ship Master Eudora]] + [[Monstrous Macaw]] + [[Titus Rivendare||97408]] + some goldens

all_comps_including_dropped.name: Pirates - Golden/End Of Turn
all_comps_including_dropped.how_to_play: At the end of turn, have a bunch of goldens to buff with [[Yorik Smite]]. Drakkari is necessary, and try goldening as many [[Goldgrubber]] with [[Elite Navigator]] as possible.

all_comps_including_dropped.name: Quilboar - Combat Scaling
all_comps_including_dropped.summary: Unleash high attack gems during combat.
all_comps_including_dropped.how_to_play: Scale your gems mainly using [[Prickly Piper]] and/or [[Vinespeaker]] and cycling every [[Moon-Bacon Jazzer]] and [[Fearless Foodie||113154]] that you see. Then, Using [[Redtusk Thornraiser]] to reborn all your quilboars, most importantly Piper and [[Three Lil Quilboar]]. [[Bristlebach]] makes you really strong because of all your reborns, especially when paired with reborn [[Glowgullet Warlord]]. You may reborn taunt [[Pufferquil]], so the reborned Pufferquil also gets venom. You may run an [[Earthsong Shaman]] just to add many stats at the end of the turn. Of course, cycle every [[Hog Watcher]] to give your quilboars Divine Shield.

all_comps_including_dropped.name: Quilboar - Gems from Hand
all_comps_including_dropped.how_to_play: First, you need [[Prickly Piper]] to enable this build, as it relies on having decent sized gems. When you have prophet + surveyor setup, cycle only good quilboars, which include [[Sun bacon relaxer]], [[Razorfen Geomancer||70143]], and [[Moon bacon Jazzer]]. After you find [[Geomagus Roogug||104766]], it's very powerful to put all gems on it. [[Balinda Stonehearth||130298]] also doubles your Surveyor effect.
all_comps_including_dropped.when_to_commit: [[Prickly Piper]] + Add gems to hand ([[Prophet of the boar]]) + [[Hot Air Surveyor]]

all_comps_including_dropped.name: Quilboar - Gemsplitter
all_comps_including_dropped.how_to_play: Divine Shield Generate Gems with [[Gemsplitter]]. Put the buffed gems on the Roogug.

all_comps_including_dropped.name: Quilboars - End of Turn
all_comps_including_dropped.summary: Put gem on all minions end of turn
all_comps_including_dropped.how_to_play: With a [[Gem Rat||116434]] opener, if you triple to [[Young Murk-eye]], roll on 5 for the rest of your comp. Every single core card you roll into is twice your scaling, and [[Eyes of the Earth Mother||100601]] is worth it on [[Gem Smuggler]].

all_comps_including_dropped.name: Rally Menagerie
all_comps_including_dropped.how_to_play: [[Primeval Monstrosity]] scales your menagerie unit every time you Rally, so you want to fill out your board with the best Rally units for each tribe. I recommend ones that can get windfury, such as [[Charmwing]] or [[Holo Rover]] or [[Bonker||70173]], but non windfury ones are great to add to your board as well. I also recommend [[Geared Guard]] and [[Bile Spitter||122219]] to add some shields and venom to your board. A play that you MUST know about for this comp is that if you play a Reef Explorer on tavern 5 with every tribe in board, you're GUARANTEED to get Monstrosity.

all_comps_including_dropped.name: Theotar
all_comps_including_dropped.summary: Cycle neutrals to buff key units
all_comps_including_dropped.how_to_play: First, constantly buy monkeys from [[Treasure-seeker Elise]] until you have 2 [[Tea Master Theotar]]. Then, cycle EVERY Neutral to buff EXACTLY 3 premium menagerie units once you have 2 Theotars. Keep [[Leeroy the Reckless||90425]](s) and other poison units to fill out the rest of your board for the endgame.
all_comps_including_dropped.when_to_commit: Double [[Tea Master Theotar]], [[Tea Master Theotar]] + [[Treasure-Seeker Elise]]

all_comps_including_dropped.name: Undead - Overflow
all_comps_including_dropped.how_to_play: When the [[Cadaver Caretaker||113158]] deathrattle gets triggered, it'll buff your whole board via the [[Titus Rivendare||97408]] + [[Catacomb Crasher]] combo. Use [[Monstrous Macaw]] to further proc Cadaver's deathrattle. Instead of [[Cadaver Caretaker||113158]], you may also use [[Lava Lurker||80747]] if you've stacked it with a lot of [[Surf n' Surf]] deathrattles early. You may choose to use [[Archlich Kel'Thuzad]] on a reborn Catacomb Crasher to duplicate it every turn.

all_comps_including_dropped.name: Back to Back
all_comps_including_dropped.summary: Scale and repeatedly play specific tavern spell
all_comps_including_dropped.how_to_play: Scale spell power with [[Felfire Conjurer||120299]] + [[Drakkari Enchanter||101314]] to make your Back to Back (Tavern Spell) bigger. Then, use [[Balinda Stonehearth||130298]] to double the scaling and effectiveness of your back to backs. [[Cataclysmic Harbinger||130884]] allows you to print multiple of them every turn. Scale premium units such as [[Blade Collector||99035]].
all_comps_including_dropped.when_to_commit: Back to Back generation ([[Cataclysmic Harbinger||130884]]) + spell power ([[Felfire Conjurer||120299]]) + [[Drakkari Enchanter||101314]]

all_comps_including_dropped.name: Beasts - Burrower
all_comps_including_dropped.how_to_play: Must play with a EARLY [[Silithid Burrower]] with an avenge setup. Spend your first 2 or 3 turns with Burrower in the back scaling it up. In the meantime, roll for the core cards of your comp. At some point, cut your avenge setup for trigger deathrattle effects on [[Silithid Burrower]] with cards such as [[Monstrous Macaw]] or [[Titus Rivendare||97408]].

all_comps_including_dropped.name: Beasts - Stegodon
all_comps_including_dropped.how_to_play: Initially attack with your [[Stomping Stegodon]]. Make sure that you have a taunted [[Sewer Rat]] or any multi-hit taunt to soak some attacks. Then, the next things to attack should be [[Manasaber]] then [[Sewer Lord||130996]] because this fills out the board with a lot of taunts that protect your Poultron. Every 4 things that die will give your board insane rallys because your Poultron's will attack and swing with all the combined rallies. Also don't reborn your Stegodon!! With [[Sprightly Scarab||108909]], you want to first reborn your Poultrons, then the Manasabers and Sewer Lord. Comp is much better if your Poultron is golden.

all_comps_including_dropped.name: Dragons - Shiny Ring
all_comps_including_dropped.summary: Attack many times to scale board in combat
all_comps_including_dropped.how_to_play: Scale your spells using [[Felfire Conjurer||120299]] or [[Tranquil Meditative||119942]]. Then, use [[Ring Bearer]] to cast as many shiny rings mid combat as possible. In order to attack as many times as possible, use [[Twilight Hatchling]] and [[Twilight Broodmother]] paired with [[Titus Rivendare||97408]]. Finally, [[Maelstrom Emergent]] serves as a multiplier for the comp, while [[Persistent Poet||108463]] is able to capture permanent stats.

all_comps_including_dropped.name: Mechs - Divine Shield
all_comps_including_dropped.how_to_play: Use [[Charging Czarina||110321]] to buff your divine shields. [[Deflect-o-bot||61930]] is your best divine shield unit, while [[Divine Sparkbot]] + reborn is your spell generation. Buy every spell that effectively costs 1 (such as [[Recruit a Trainee||103793]] and [[Fortify||103791]]).

all_comps_including_dropped.name: Nagas - Combat Scaling/Spell Buff
all_comps_including_dropped.how_to_play: Proc [[Ruthless Queensguard]]'s deathratte effect as many times as possible. Your Queen's commands benefit from spell buff ([[Tranquil Meditative||119942]]). [[Maelstrom Emergent]], [[Rylak Metalhead]], reborn on it, [[Titus Rivendare||97408]], [[Monstrous Macaw]], [[Brann Bronzebeard||96786]] all add multiplier effects on the amount of Queen's Command you cast. For higher cap, have a golden Rylak and put spell power dragon on the left and Queensguard on the right.

all_comps_including_dropped.name: Undead - Carapace
all_comps_including_dropped.how_to_play: Buff the Attack of Tavern Spells with [[Friendly Geist||120219]], and generate [[Haunted Carapace]] spells using [[Carapace Raiser]]. Titus is crucial because it double both of those effects. These spells will buff your board AND summons a ton of attack, so you want the rest of your board to be token spawners, such as [[Twilight Broodmother]]. Finally, use [[Prosthetic Hand||112364]] to reborn your core Undeads.

all_comps_including_dropped.name: Dragons - Whelps
all_comps_including_dropped.summary: Summon huge whelps that attack immediately
all_comps_including_dropped.how_to_play: Scale your Whelps by proccing [[Burgeoning Whelp]] as many times as possible. Most commonly, you use [[Brann Bronzebeard||96786]], [[Titus Rivendare||97408]], reborn [[Rylak Metalhead]], and [[Monstrous Macaw]] provides the most optimal scaling setup for this comp. For your summons, two [[Twilight Broodmother]] is good enough. You may run [[Twilight Hatchling]] when it's time to go all in.
all_comps_including_dropped.when_to_commit: Whelp scaling ([[Burgeoning Whelp]]) + Whelp generation ([[Twilight Broodmother]])

all_comps_including_dropped.name: Elementals - APM Violet
all_comps_including_dropped.how_to_play: Cycle as many elementals as you can with [[Ultraviolet Ascendant]] on board. The best way to do that is with [[Brann Bronzebeard||96786]], and then buying every [[Tavern Tempest||64077]], [[Sellemental||64038]], and [[Refreshing Anomaly||64042]]. Golden [[Ichoron the Protector]] is nice to shield your whole board, and [[Lantern Lava]] can be used to copy an amazing elemental every turn, ideally [[Tavern Tempest||64077]].

all_comps_including_dropped.name: Quilboar - Gem Barrage
all_comps_including_dropped.how_to_play: First, scale your gems, typically through cycling [[Moon-bacon Jazzer]] and [[Fearless Foodie||113154]] and keeping a [[Prickly Piper]]. Then, scale shop using Gem Barrage. This is usually done with [[Titus Rivendare||97408]] + [[Razorfen Flapper||126667]] + [[Monstrous Macaw]], but could be done with [[Rylak Metalhead]] + [[Briarback Drummer||126669]] as well. Finally, the payoff for your buffed shops include [[Trench Fighter||126671]] so you can use your Gem Confiscation in shop to triple its stats, and [[Felboar||110664]] to eat buffed units in the shop.
all_comps_including_dropped.when_to_commit: Gem scaling ([[Prickly Piper]]) + Razorfen Flapper + payoff ([[Trench Fighter||126671]]/[[Felboar||110664]])

all_comps_including_dropped.name: Beasts - Raptor Top 4
all_comps_including_dropped.how_to_play: With [[Raptor Elder]] in the back, play as many summons as possible. First, have reborn [[Manasaber]] die, which forces left to right combat which is great for you. In the end, refill your board with strong [[Mechanized Gift Horse]] summons. The best card to go in position one or two is [[Leeroy the Reckless||90425]].

all_comps_including_dropped.name: Murlocs - Magicfin
all_comps_including_dropped.summary: Teach Murlocs spells and proc them
all_comps_including_dropped.how_to_play: This comp relies on teaching a great spell to Magicfin Apprentice and proccing it over and over again. [[Young Murk-eye]] is a must to proc these spells every turn, with its effect amplified by [[Brann Bronzebeard||96786]] and [[Drakkari Enchanter||101314]]. Teach the apprentice [[Shiny ring||109230]], [[Azerite Empowerment||109232]], or [[Time management||117573]] with some spell scaling, which comes from [[Felfire Conjurer||120299]]. Early on, it may be nice to teach it some econ spell as well, notable [[Strike Oil||104029]]. Do not triple Young Murk-eye in this comp! It doesn't increase your scaling.

all_comps_including_dropped.name: Nalaa
all_comps_including_dropped.summary: Buy spells to scale Menagerie units.
all_comps_including_dropped.how_to_play: Buy every single spell that effectively costs 1 (Fleeting Vigor, Enchanted Lasso), to scale your good menagerie units. [[Stuntdrake]] and [[Niuzao]] are the most important cards to scale. Eventually, you can replace your worst units with summons such as [[Twilight Broodmother]] to help support the [[Stuntdrake]].
all_comps_including_dropped.when_to_commit: [[Nalaa the Redeemer]] + Spell Generation ([[Visionary Shipman]])/Good tribes ([[Whirling Lass-o-matic]])

all_comps_including_dropped.name: Beasts - RDU
all_comps_including_dropped.summary: Cycle beasts to damage themselves and scale
all_comps_including_dropped.how_to_play: Use [[Rylak Metalhead]] + [[Hunting Tiger Shark]] to generate lots of beasts every turn. [[Monstrous Macaw]], [[Brann Bronzebeard||96786]], reborn, and [[Titus Rivendare||97408]] all amplify this effect. When you have your scaling setup with [[Rabid Panther]] + [[Iridescent Skyblazer]] or double Rabid Panther, start buying every single beast to scale your board.

all_comps_including_dropped.name: Elementals - Ballers
all_comps_including_dropped.how_to_play: The strat involves staying on tavern 2 and buying every [[Fire Baller||116736]] and [[Snow baller||117667]] you see. You should also buy your first 5-8 Strike Oils that you see, and every refresh spell. Specific heroes that give economy are much much better at this strat than your average hero. Chromie can buy all the tier 2 spells which gives you lots of free economy, Nobundo can copy a Strike Oil every turn, Cenarius can press hero power every turn, Kurtrus can get a free baller every turn, and Sire can get Temporal Tampering which is an auto win with this strat. Without a great hero power, you must rely on a good Timewarped card, such as Snow Elemental or Skipper or else it is unplayable, and you should level to play normally.
all_comps_including_dropped.when_to_commit: Specific hero or Timewarped Skipper/Snow Elemental on tavern 2

all_comps_including_dropped.name: Elementals - NOMI
all_comps_including_dropped.how_to_play: First, scale elementals in shop using [[Nomi, Kitchen Nightmare||63626]]. [[Brann Bronzebeard||96786]] really helps generate Elementals because the tribe has a lot of great battlecries. Then, print Avalanche spells with [[Avalanche Caller]]. Initially, you may also print [[Avalanche Caller]] using [[Lantern Lava]] if you have 2 or more. Most of your economy comes from duplicating [[Tavern Tempest||64077]] using [[Lantern Lava]] so be sure to set that up. Use Avalanche spells onto a permanent elemental, usually Avalanche Caller or Lantern Lava.
all_comps_including_dropped.when_to_commit: [[Brann Bronzebeard||96786]] + [[Lantern Lava]] for econ into [[Nomi, Kitchen Nightmare||63626]]

all_comps_including_dropped.name: Elementals - Rightmost Buff
all_comps_including_dropped.summary: Buff rightmost minion in shop to scale
all_comps_including_dropped.how_to_play: First use [[Rylak Metalhead]] + [[Refreshing Anomaly||64042]] + [[Brann Bronzebeard||96786]] for infinite rolls. Add multipliers such as [[Monstrous Macaw]] and [[Titus Rivendare||97408]]. With so much economy, start cycling and proccing [[En-Djinn Blazer||126175]] to buff your right most minion a ton. [[Acid Rainfall]] is your main payoff for having a buffed right most minion. If you don't choose the Rylak line, you can choose to spend gold with [[Fleet Admiral Tethys]] and [[Visionary Shipman]], then buff the rightmost minion with [[Acid Rainfall]].
all_comps_including_dropped.when_to_commit: [[Brann Bronzebeard||96786]] (good economy) + Rightmost shop buffer([[Air Revenant||126173]]) + [[Acid Rainfall]]

all_comps_including_dropped.name: Elementals - Shop Buff/Spells
all_comps_including_dropped.summary: Make big units in shop to scale.
all_comps_including_dropped.how_to_play: First, buff the shop. This is usually done by having [[Rylak Metalhead]] + [[Dancing Barnstormer||99523]] or [[En-Djinn Blazer||126175]]. Keep [[Leyline Surfacer]] for stats. Double the effect of the [[Arcane Absorption]] you get from Leyline using [[Balinda Stonehearth||130298]]. In the endgame, scale up [[Wildfire Elemental||64189]].

all_comps_including_dropped.name: Quilboar - Charlga
all_comps_including_dropped.summary: Cast blood gems end of turn
all_comps_including_dropped.how_to_play: After you have gem scaling, put down a [[Charlga]] to scale your board at the end of every turn. [[Drakkari Enchanter||101314]] amplifies this effect.

all_comps_including_dropped.name: Quilboar - Darkgaze
all_comps_including_dropped.summary: Spend gold to cast blood gems
all_comps_including_dropped.how_to_play: After you have [[Darkgaze Elder]] and buffed gems ([[Prickly Piper]]), your objective is to spend as much gold as possible. This is usually done if you have [[Brann Bronzebeard||96786]], and you cycle every free battlecry such as [[Shell Collector||80740]] and [[Tavern Tempest||64077]]. You also want to cycle every [[Moon bacon Jazzer]] and [[Fearless foodie||113154]] to help scale. Any quilboar in the addon section is good to fill out the rest of your board.

all_comps_including_dropped.name: Quilboar - Rally
all_comps_including_dropped.summary: Scale blood gems and play them with Rally
all_comps_including_dropped.how_to_play: Scale your bloodgems using an early [[Sanguine Refiner||122566]]. Then, [[Razorfen Vineweaver||122562]] casts 3 or more permanent gems on itself each fight, while [[Bloodsnout Warlord]] casts an insane amount of temporary gems on your board. Taunt is important in this comp, and use it on either [[Charlga]] or any Divine Shield
all_comps_including_dropped.when_to_commit: Gem Scaling ([[Sanguine Refiner||122566]]) + Payoff ([[Razorfen Vineweaver||122562]]/[[Bloodsnout Warlord]])

all_comps_including_dropped.name: Quilboar - Smuggler
all_comps_including_dropped.how_to_play: **MUST HAVE BEASTS** Before you start proccing [[Gem Smuggler]], you want to scale your gems as much as possible, typically with [[Prickly Piper]] and also proccing [[Moon bacon Jazzer]] as much as possible. In the midgame, use [[Three Lil' Quilboar]] or [[Bristlebach]] to stabilize. The final variation of this comp uses [[Rylak Metalhead]] to proc the [[Gem Smuggler]]. Then, reborn on the Rylak, [[Monstrous Macaw]], [[Brann Bronzebeard||96786]], and [[Titus Rivendare||97408]] all act as multipliers to the Rylak effect. If you have golden Rylak, then you can try to proc both Jazzer and Smuggler. You can choose to add in [[Tarecgosa||72062]] to keep gems.
all_comps_including_dropped.when_to_commit: [[Brann Bronzebeard||96786]] + Gem Scaling ([[Prickly Piper]]) + [[Gem Smuggler]] + [[Rylak Metalhead]]
